arxiv-2009-01195.title: Garain at SemEval-2020 Task 12: Sequence based Deep Learning for Categorizing Offensive Language in Social Media
arxiv-2009-01195.creator: Avishek Garain
arxiv-2009-01195.description: Abstract SemEval-2020 Task 12 was OffenseEval: Multilingual Offensive Language Identification in Social Media [ \citenameZampieri et al.2020 ] . The task was subdivided into multiple languages and datasets were provided for each one. The task was further divided into three sub-tasks: offensive language identification, automatic categorization of offense types, and offense target identification.

arxiv-2012-14975.title: Uncrowding algorithm for hook-valued tableaux
arxiv-2012-14975.creator: Jianping Pan, Joseph Pappe, Wencin Poh, Anne Schilling
arxiv-2012-14975.description: Abstract . Whereas set-valued tableaux are the combinatorial objects associated to stable Grothendieck polynomials, hook-valued tableaux are associated to stable canonical Grothendieck polynomials. In this paper, we define a novel uncrowding algorithm for hook-valued tableaux. The algorithm “uncrowds” the entries in the arm of the hooks and yields a set-valued tableau and a column-flagged increasing tableau.

arxiv-2107-00227.title: UrbanVR: An immersive analytics system for context-aware urban design Journal: Computers & Graphics
arxiv-2107-00227.creator: Chi Zhang, Wei Zeng, Ligang Liu
arxiv-2107-00227.description: Abstract Urban design is a highly visual discipline that requires visualization for informed decision making. However, traditional urban design tools are mostly limited to representations on 2D displays that lack intuitive awareness. The popularity of head-mounted displays (HMDs) promotes a promising alternative with consumer-grade 3D displays.

arxiv-2111-14018.title: How Can Applications of Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence Improve Performance of Internet of Things? -- A Survey
arxiv-2111-14018.creator: Priyanka Bothra, Raja Karmakar, Sanjukta Bhattacharya, Sayantani De
arxiv-2111-14018.description: Abstract In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), massive computing devices surrounding us operate and interact with each other to provide several significant services in industries, medical as well as in daily life activities at home, office, education sectors, and so on.

arxiv-2203-13813.title: A Fock state lattice approach to quantum optics
arxiv-2203-13813.creator: Pil Saugmann and Jonas Larson
arxiv-2203-13813.description: Abstract We analyze a set of models frequently appearing in quantum optical settings by expressing their Hamiltonians in terms of Fock-state lattices (FSLs). The few degrees-of-freedom of such models, together with the system symmetries, make the emerging FSLs rather simple such that they can be linked to known lattice models from the condensed matter community.

arxiv-2408-03893.title: Investigation of pion-nucleon contributions to nucleon matrix elements
arxiv-2408-03893.creator: Constantia Alexandrou, Giannis Koutsou, Yan Li, Marcus Petschlies, Ferenc Pittler
arxiv-2408-03893.description: Abstract We investigate contributions of excited states to nucleon matrix elements computed in lattice QCD by employing, in addition to the standard nucleon interpolating operator, pion-nucleon ( π \pi - N N ) operators. We solve a generalized eigenvalue problem (GEVP) to obtain an optimal interpolating operator that minimizes overlap with the π \pi - N N states.

arxiv-2410-01290.title: Towards a Law of Iterated Expectations for Heuristic Estimators
arxiv-2410-01290.creator: Paul Christiano, Jacob Hilton, Andrea Lincoln, Eric Neyman, Mark Xu
arxiv-2410-01290.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Paul Christiano, Jacob Hilton, Andrea Lincoln, Eric Neyman, Mark Xu. 2022a define a heuristic estimator to be a hypothetical algorithm that estimates the values of mathematical expressions from arguments. In brief, a heuristic estimator 𝔾 \mathbb{G} takes as input a mathematical expression Y Y and a formal “heuristic argument” π \pi , and outputs an estimate 𝔾 ⁡ ( Y ∣ π ) \mathbb{G}(Y\mid\pi) of Y Y .

arxiv-2501-00535.title: Tensor Topic Modeling Via HOSVD
arxiv-2501-00535.creator: Yating Liu, Claire Donnat
arxiv-2501-00535.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yating Liu, Claire Donnat. By representing documents as mixtures of topics, topic modeling has allowed the successful analysis of datasets across a wide spectrum of applications ranging from ecology to genetics. An important body of recent work has demonstrated the computational and statistical efficiency of probabilistic Latent Semantic Indexing (pLSI)– a type of topic modeling— in estimating both the topic matrix (corresponding to distributions over word frequencies), and the topic assignment matrix.

arxiv-2505-11120.title: Search for dwarf galaxies in the southwestern sector of the Local cosmic void
arxiv-2505-11120.creator: A.A.Popova
arxiv-2505-11120.description: Abstract Abstract We performed a search for new dwarf galaxies in a direction towards the southwestern part of the Local Void using the data on DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys. In a sky area of \sim 1000 square degrees, we discovered 12 candidates to nearby dwarfs with a high confidence.

arxiv-2505-12576.title: AdaDim: Dimensionality Adaptation for SSL Representational Dynamics
arxiv-2505-12576.creator: Kiran Kokilepersaud, Mohit Prabhushankar, Ghassan AlRegib
arxiv-2505-12576.description: Abstract A key factor in effective Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) is preventing dimensional collapse, where higher-dimensional representation spaces span a lower-dimensional subspace. Therefore, SSL optimization strategies involve guiding a model to produce a representation space with a higher dimensionality through objectives that encourage feature decorrelation or sample uniformity.

arxiv-2507-20852.title: Millimeter VLBI constraints on the central magnetic field and symmetric jet production in the twin-jet galaxy NGC 1052
arxiv-2507-20852.creator: L. Ricci, A.-K. Baczko, M. Kadler, C. M. Fromm, A. Saiz-Pérez, E. Ros, S. del Palacio, T. P. Krichbaum, M. Perucho, G. F. Paraschos
arxiv-2507-20852.description: Abstract Aims. This paper investigates the symmetry and magnetic field properties of the jets in the radio galaxy NGC 1052, with particular attention to the impact of the ionized torus that surrounds the central region on the emitted radiation. Methods.

arxiv-2510-13281.title: Two Heads Are Better Than One: Audio-Visual Speech Error Correction with Dual Hypotheses
arxiv-2510-13281.creator: Sungnyun Kim, Kangwook Jang, Sungwoo Cho, Joon Son Chung, Hoirin Kim, Se-Young Yun, [0.5em] Kim Jaechul Graduate School of AI, KAIST
arxiv-2510-13281.description: Abstract This paper introduces a new paradigm for generative error correction (GER) framework in audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) that reasons over modality-specific evidences directly in the language space. Our framework, DualHyp , empowers a large language model (LLM) to compose independent N N -best hypotheses from separate automatic speech recognition (ASR) and visual speech recognition (VSR) models.

pmc-10683060.title: ent-Clavilactone J and Its Quinone Derivative, Meroterpenoids from the Fungus Resupinatus sp.
pmc-10683060.creator: Karen Harms, Pathompong Paomephan, Thitiya Boonpratuang, Rattaket Choeyklin, Chuenchit Boonchird, Frank Surup
pmc-10683060.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Metabolites 1 and 2, isolated from cultures of the basidiomycete Resupinatus sp. BCC84615, collected in a tropical forest in northeastern Thailand, showed weak antibiotic activity against Bacillus subtilis and Staphylococcus aureus and cytotoxicity against cancer cell lines. Their planar structures were elucidated by high-resolution electrospray ionization mass spectrometry and NMR spectroscopy as clavilactone J, known from the basidiomycete Ampulloclitocybe clavipes, and its new 1,4-benzoquinone derivative.

pmc-11773645.title: Trends and socioeconomic inequalities in receiving vitamin A supplementation among children aged 6–59 months in Bangladesh: analysis of nationwide cross-sectional data from 2004 to 2017
pmc-11773645.creator: Syed Sharaf Ahmed Chowdhury, Satyajit Kundu, Ishrat Jahan, Rakhi Dey, Azaz Bin Sharif, Ahmed Hossain
pmc-11773645.description: IntroductionThe coverage of vitamin A supplementation (VAS) is still short of the target set by the government to reach 90% coverage of VAS in Bangladesh. The present study aims to examine the socioeconomic and geographical inequalities in receiving VAS among children aged 6–59 months in Bangladesh from 2004 to 2017.

pmc-12469385.title: Demographic Profile and Work Stress of Nursing Professionals in Public Hospitals in Aracaju, Sergipe
pmc-12469385.creator: Tânia Pereira dos Santos, Jeane dos Santos Ferreira, Calliandra Maria de Souza Silva, Izabel Cristina Rodrigues da Silva, Rita de Cássia Coelho Almeida Akutsu
pmc-12469385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Occupational or work-related stress remains a persistent challenge in nursing, often intensified by sociodemographic factors. In Brazil’s Northeast, particularly in Aracaju, Sergipe, public hospital nurses face unique stressors shaped by regional socioeconomic conditions. Objective: This cross-sectional exploratory study aimed to examine the relationship between perceived work-related stress and the sociodemographic profiles of nursing professionals in three public hospitals in Aracaju. Methods: Data were collected via an online questionnaire incorporating the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) and sociodemographic items.

pmc-12528598.title: Breaking Barriers: Advancing Equity and Support for Women in Plastic Surgery
pmc-12528598.creator: Meeti Mehta, Ruvi Chauhan, Tara L. Huston, Paige L. Myers, Carolyn De La Cruz, Paris D. Butler
pmc-12528598.description: Summary:Despite recent modest increases, women remain underrepresented in the plastic surgery workforce, particularly in leadership roles. This disparity highlights the need for systemic, cultural, and professional changes to foster equity and support for women in the field. This article outlined key barriers faced by women in plastic surgery and provided actionable recommendations for improvement.

pmc-12604584.title: Uterine NK Cell Polarization Associates with Chronic Endometritis and Predisposition to Recurrent Implantation Failure
pmc-12604584.creator: Qiuyin Xie, Lu Zhang, Jing Yang, Mengjie Yang, Qiyuan Li, Qionghua Chen
pmc-12604584.description: BackgroundDisturbances in the endometrial immune microenvironment, particularly uterine natural killer (uNK) cell polarization, are linked to chronic endometritis (CE) and recurrent implantation failure (RIF). However, the underlying mechanisms and a lack of reliable biomarkers hinder effective clinical diagnosis and treatment.MethodsWe integrated public single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets to characterize endometrial immune cell dynamics.

pmc-12646788.title: Gooey stuff: the psychophysics of unpleasantness in response to touching liquids
pmc-12646788.creator: Müge Cavdan, Maja Fehlberg, Roland Bennewitz, Knut Drewing
pmc-12646788.description: There is a growing scientific interest in material unpleasantness, yet the role of distinct physical parameters in perceptual and affective haptic experiences with liquids remains to be fully understood. To address this, we investigated how perceptual qualities of liquids relate to measurable physical properties and unpleasantness during active touch. We prepared 15 custom liquid samples using everyday materials.

pmc-12836561.title: Benchmarking cancer outcomes in Europe: a scoping review of methodologies and case-mix adjustments
pmc-12836561.creator: J. Thurell, L. Doppelbauer, E.M. Verheul, I. Petrov, M.M. Karsten, L.B. Koppert, J. Bergh, I. Fredriksson, P. Lindgren, N. Kiani, E. Hedayati
pmc-12836561.description: BackgroundBenchmarking hospital outcomes is crucial for identifying inequities and improving cancer care. Meaningful comparisons require selecting relevant outcomes and adjusting for case-mix factors such as age, comorbidity, and stage. Without case-mix adjustment, hospitals may be unfairly assessed based on patient mix rather than care quality. No prior review has examined benchmarking practices in European cancer care.

pmc-13136314.title: Mediating role of self-efficacy in the association between multidimensional resource support and postdoctoral job satisfaction
pmc-13136314.creator: Xinqiao Liu, Xinyuan Zhang, Yan Li, Huirui Zhang
pmc-13136314.description: As the core research talent in the challenging and competitive research field, the job satisfaction of postdocs is highly important for research output, technological advancement, and the future reserve of talent. This study explores the impact of resource support on postdoctoral job satisfaction using data from Nature’s 2023 postdoc survey.

pmc-13246015.title: Image registration improves inter-reader agreement of objective response in CT assessment of pancreas adenocarcinoma☆
pmc-13246015.creator: Jon S Heiselman, Natally Horvat, Maria El Homsi, Burcin Agridag-Ucpinar, Onur Yildirim, Mithat Gonen, Brett L Ecker, Eileen M O’Reilly, Jeffrey A Drebin, Vinod P Balachandran, T Peter Kingham, Kevin C Soares, Michael I D’Angelica, Richard KG Do, William R Jarnagin, Alice C Wei, Jayasree Chakraborty
pmc-13246015.description: Objectives:Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) exhibits ill-defined appearance on imaging during neoadjuvant therapy (NAT), which may limit consistency of dimensional measurements for objective response. This study evaluates inter-reader variability of current clinical measures of tumor size and interval response between baseline and restaging CT, and compares reader reliability with and without image registration assistance.

pmc-13367084.creator: Rashid Iqbal, Salman Ahmad, Khaqan Suleiman, Ghulam Murtaza, Sajid Ullah, Wiwiek Harsonowati, Dilfuza Jabborova, Sidra Ahmad, Allah Ditta, Mohamed Taha Yassin
pmc-13367084.description: Drought-induced reduction in crop yield is becoming a serious threat worldwide, especially in arid to semiarid regions. The introduction of medicinal plants into cropping patterns in arid regions is a suitable alternative to conventional crops because of their high demand and market value.

pmc-13450267.title: Ensuring Knowledge Transfer: The Critical Role of “What-If” Discussions in Virtual Patient Simulation
pmc-13450267.creator: Zhien Li, Maryam Asoodar, Tom Keulers, Desirée Joosten-ten Brinke, Diana Dolmans
pmc-13450267.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Virtual Patient (VP) systems are widely used in medical education, yet evidence on how they support near and far transfer remains limited. This study investigates integrating VPs with role modelling, varied case practices, and “what-if” discussions.

pmc-13456531.title: Social Media as a Driver of Obesity in Children and Adolescents (Aged 6-18 Years): It Is Time for Regulatory Action
pmc-13456531.creator: Yuwei Liu, Wenyun Li, Li Ming Wen, Gengsheng He
pmc-13456531.description: Obesity in children and adolescents is rising in China and globally, with health consequences that are already evident during childhood. This Viewpoint represents the authors’ interpretation of current evidence and policy experience, using China as an illustrative case for a wider international challenge.
